report_name: JetBrains Patches Critical Flaws in IDEs, TeamCity CI/CD Platform

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The vulnerabilities in JetBrains TeamCity and IDEs could allow an attacker to inject malicious code into an organization's software products before they are built and shipped to customers, representing a significant software supply chain risk.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: A remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-65907) in the public-facing TeamCity CI/CD server could be exploited by an attacker to gain control over build processes and the server itself.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
attack_patterns.description: A command injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-49366) in IntelliJ-based IDEs allows for the execution of arbitrary commands through filename autocompletion, which could spawn shells like cmd.exe, powershell.exe, or bash on a developer's workstation.

attack_patterns.name: Virtualization/Sandbox Evasion
attack_patterns.description: A sandbox escape vulnerability (CVE-2026-65906) in TeamCity's Kotlin DSL allows an attacker who can influence build scripts to break out of the constrained environment and compromise the underlying host server.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-65907
vulnerabilities.description: A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in TeamCity's Git Version Control System (VCS) Roots, allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the TeamCity server.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-65906
vulnerabilities.description: A sandbox escape vulnerability in TeamCity's Kotlin DSL leading to code execution on the TeamCity server.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-49366
vulnerabilities.description: A command injection vulnerability in IntelliJ-based IDEs via filename completion, allowing arbitrary command execution on a developer's workstation.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-64814
vulnerabilities.description: An unauthorized file access vulnerability during remote development sessions in IntelliJ-based IDEs, allowing an attacker to read sensitive files.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-64813
vulnerabilities.description: An unauthorized setting modification vulnerability in IntelliJ-based IDEs, which could be used to weaken security settings.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-59794
vulnerabilities.description: A stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in a JetBrains product.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-59793
vulnerabilities.description: An arbitrary file access flaw in the Perforce integration for a JetBrains product.

identities.name: Software Development Organizations
identities.description: Organizations using JetBrains TeamCity and IntelliJ-based IDEs are at risk of supply chain attacks and infrastructure compromise due to the patched vulnerabilities.

indicators.name: JetBrains TeamCity Server Spawning Suspicious Shell
indicators.pattern:
title: JetBrains TeamCity Server Spawning Suspicious Shell
id: 2b8a1c9d-5b7e-4f3a-8d6c-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the JetBrains TeamCity server process (typically java.exe) spawning common command shells, which could indicate exploitation of RCE vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-65907 or CVE-2026-65906.
references:
  - https://seceon.com/critical-jetbrains-vulnerabilities-could-allow-attackers-to-execute-malicious-code/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-05
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1497
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|contains: 'java.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'TeamCity'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
indicators.description: Detects the JetBrains TeamCity server process (java.exe) spawning common command shells, which could indicate exploitation of RCE vulnerabilities like CVE-2026-65907 or CVE-2026-65906.
